name: UK strikes & disruption
value: No national strike; consultants' action paused
summary: BMA paused the 25–26 Nov consultants' strike for talks; Tube strikes from 26 Nov are London-only
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that the consultants' strike in England planned for 25 and 26 Nov is paused while formal negotiations with the government take place (BMA). RMT plans 24-hour London Underground strikes from noon on 26 Nov, 17 Dec and 19 Dec, with more dates into February, expected to close several lines (Ianvisits, 6 Nov). These are London-only, and searches on 20 Nov found no national-scale strike or nationwide infrastructure disruption due, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: London travellers should check TfL for strike days from 26 Nov. NHS services in England are expected to run as normal on 25 and 26 Nov.
rubric_hit: Normal: no national strike due (BMA consultants' 25–26 Nov action paused); Tube strikes are London-only

sources.title: BMA — Consultant action in England paused as BMA secures negotiations to end dispute
Ianvisits — Tube strikes announced in the weeks up to Christmas

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
